text: What should you not talk about on a first date? Here's the golden rule. Avoid anything serious, heavy, or straight up controversial. So what topics you should actually avoid? Topic one, politics. If you have different political views, it can create bad vibes. Topic two, religion. This topic could be too deep and too obscure for the first date. Topic three, exes, other women, and other partners. You are on a date with this girl, so concentrate on her. Do not talk about other girls with her. Topic four, money. A lot of the time talking about money can look like you are either bragging or that you are cheap. So try to avoid this topic too. Topic five, illnesses, personal traumas, negative experiences. You should be having good time with each other. This is a date, not a therapy session. Once again, first date is about vibes, not debates. Be light, be playful, be present.
